title: metamodel-assetChangeEvent.v1
description: Metamodel-aligned schema for Asset change events. Uses AAS Reference objects as defined in IDTA-01001. Submodel references use ModelReference<Submodel>; AAS references use ModelReference<AssetAdministrationShell>.

Key.description: A single key within a Reference chain. Corresponds to Key in the AAS metamodel (IDTA-01001).

type.description: The model element type this key refers to.

value.description: The identifier or local ID of the referenced element.

Reference.description: A Reference as defined in the AAS metamodel (IDTA-01001). Can be an ExternalReference or a ModelReference.

type.description: Distinguishes between external references (e.g. IRDIs, IRIs) and model-internal references.

keys.description: Ordered sequence of keys forming the reference path.

referredSemanticId.description: Optional: semantic ID of the referenced element.

ModelReferenceToSubmodel.description: A ModelReference<Submodel>: a navigable reference whose first key has type 'Submodel'. Corresponds to ModelReference<Submodel> in the AAS metamodel.

type.description: Must be 'ModelReference' for a model-internal reference.

keys.description: Reference chain. The first key must have type 'Submodel' and value equal to the Submodel.id.

referredSemanticId.description: Optional: semantic ID of the referenced submodel.

ModelReferenceToAAS.description: A ModelReference<AssetAdministrationShell>: a navigable reference whose first key has type 'AssetAdministrationShell'. Corresponds to ModelReference<AssetAdministrationShell> in the AAS metamodel.

type.description: Must be 'ModelReference' for a model-internal reference.

keys.description: Reference chain. The first key must have type 'AssetAdministrationShell' and value equal to the AssetAdministrationShell.id.

referredSemanticId.description: Optional: semantic ID of the referenced AAS.

globalAssetId.description: Global asset identifier (URI). Corresponds to AssetInformation.globalAssetId in the AAS metamodel.

submodels.description: All submodels of the asset as ModelReference<Submodel> objects. Each reference contains the Submodel.id as the first key value and may carry a referredSemanticId pointing to the submodel template.

aasRefs.description: All AAS instances managing this asset as ModelReference<AssetAdministrationShell> objects. Replaces the plain aasIds array from the non-metamodel variant.
